svg.title: N=18 disk-bounded unit-square configurations
svg.desc: Vector plot generated from exact rational circle-lattice witness data.
svg.text: Standard lower-left-corner grid. Blue squares are the induced 18-cell polyominoes; all grid vertices in or on each closed disk are plotted.
green = strict disk vertex • amber = boundary vertex • gray = ambient lattice vertex • red = circle / center
disk vertices = 28 = cell vertices; induced cells = 18
